title: Stylish Woman in Winter Coat, Snowy Field - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: Full-length outdoor portrait of a smiling young woman posing in a snowy landscape during winter. She is outfitted in quintessential 1940s wartime-era fashion, featuring a tailored knee-length wool coat with prominent padded shoulders, a high collar with toggle clasp, a belted waist, light-colored gloves, and a dark headscarf. Leafless trees and a snow-dusted open field spread across the sunny background.
